findings.highlight: cast doubt on any future performance being held
findings.evidenceJa: 「実は現在、深刻な体調不良ということで次回公演の開催が危ぶまれていることが、関係者の話で明らかになりました」
findings.explanation: The report casts doubt on the next scheduled performance—the additional concert—because of serious ill health. 'Any future performance' broadens the rumor into possible permanent cessation.
findings.japanese:
「実は現在、深刻な体調不良ということで
次回公演の開催が危ぶまれていることが、
関係者の話で明らかになりました」
findings.todokanai: "However, recent statements made by related sources have cast doubt on any future performance being held, due to poor health."

findings.highlight: Wasn't that all already decided in the plan from the very beginning?
findings.evidenceJa: 「ええ、ええ………何ですって？　そんな…それ、初っ端に向こうにハねられた企画じゃないですか」
findings.explanation: Hamada says the other party rejected that proposal at the outset. The English says it had already been decided in the plan from the beginning, reversing rejection into prior approval.
findings.japanese:
「ええ、ええ………何ですって？　そんな…
それ、初っ端に向こうにハねられた企画じゃないですか」
findings.todokanai: "Yeah, yeah… What did you just say? But that's… Wasn't that all already decided in the plan from the very beginning?"

findings.highlight: Did Yoshimatsu-san tell you about all that?
findings.evidenceJa: 「吉松さんが通したんですか？　それ。え、だから俺じゃ…」
findings.explanation: Hamada asks whether Yoshimatsu got the proposal approved. The English asks whether Yoshimatsu merely told the other person about it, losing the approval maneuver that reveals Haruki played both superiors.
findings.japanese:
「吉松さんが通したんですか？　それ。
え、だから俺じゃ…」
findings.todokanai: "Did Yoshimatsu-san tell you about all that? No, like I said, it wasn't me…"

findings.highlight: "If you're looking for Kitahara, he went home immediately after the briefing earlier. He did show his face before you came to work, though."
findings.evidenceJa:
「北原なら打ち合わせで直帰になってますよ。
浜田さんが出社する前に顔出してましたけどね」
findings.explanation: 直帰 means Haruki will go straight home after an outside meeting, not that he already went home after an earlier briefing — The essential fact that he is absent from the office is preserved.
findings.japanese:
「北原なら打ち合わせで直帰になってますよ。
浜田さんが出社する前に顔出してましたけどね」
findings.todokanai: "If you're looking for Kitahara, he went home immediately after the briefing earlier. He did show his face before you came to work, though."

findings.highlight: It seems that they're wary about meeting us
findings.evidenceJa: 「なんか会ってる気配なかったし、雪菜ちゃんに聞いても、どことなくぎこちなかったし」
findings.explanation: Takeya says there has been no sign Haruki and Setsuna are seeing each other, and Setsuna acted awkward when asked. The English instead says the couple are wary of meeting Takeya and Io, replacing the suspected romantic separation with social avoidance of the speakers.
findings.japanese:
「なんか会ってる気配なかったし、
雪菜ちゃんに聞いても、どことなくぎこちなかったし」
findings.todokanai: "It seems that they're wary about meeting us, and Setsuna-chan didn't really give me anything to work with when I inquired about things on her end."

findings.highlight: Could he have gotten himself involved in Touma's affairs again?
findings.evidenceJa: 「…まさかあいつ、まだ冬馬のこと引きずってるんじゃないだろうな」
findings.explanation: Takeya fears Haruki may still be emotionally hung up on Touma. The English reduces this to renewed involvement in her affairs, erasing the romantic suspicion driving Io's panic.
findings.japanese:
「…まさかあいつ、
まだ冬馬のこと引きずってるんじゃないだろうな」
findings.todokanai: "…Could he have gotten himself involved in Touma's affairs again?"

findings.highlight: "…And you can't even reassure yourself properly despite causing me to worry."
findings.evidenceJa:
「…しかも人の不安煽っておいて
自己解決しないでよね」
findings.explanation: Io objects that Takeya stirred up her anxiety and then resolved the issue only for himself; the English says he cannot reassure himself properly — Her frustration at being left anxious remains evident.
findings.japanese:
「…しかも人の不安煽っておいて
自己解決しないでよね」
findings.todokanai: "…And you can't even reassure yourself properly despite causing me to worry."

findings.highlight: people will be less skeptical when my illness is reported on.
findings.evidenceJa: 「…なるほど、かずさの件がガセとわかったら、今度は冬馬曜子だと言っても誰も信用しない、か」
findings.explanation: Youko realizes that once the Kazusa illness story is exposed as false, nobody will believe a later report that the patient was actually Youko. The English says people will become less skeptical—more likely to believe her illness—the exact opposite of Miyoko's diversion.
findings.japanese:
「…なるほど、かずさの件がガセとわかったら、
今度は冬馬曜子だと言っても誰も信用しない、か」
findings.todokanai: "…I see. Once it is made known Kazusa was fine all along, people will be less skeptical when my illness is reported on."

findings.highlight: The moment you made your decision, I started working on everything
findings.evidenceJa: 「社長が決断した瞬間に、すぐに各方面が動けるように手配しています。損害も最小限に抑えられるように手を打ちました」
findings.explanation: Miyoko has arranged matters so every party can move the instant Youko makes her still-pending decision. The English says Youko already decided and Miyoko only then began work, contradicting the prepared-options discussion.
findings.japanese:
「社長が決断した瞬間に、
すぐに各方面が動けるように手配しています。
損害も最小限に抑えられるように手を打ちました」
findings.todokanai: "The moment you made your decision, I started working on everything on all sides, minimizing the possible damage."

findings.highlight: I feel tired enough to want to call a taxi.
findings.evidenceJa: 始発が動き出すまでにはまだ時間があり、タクシーを使ってまで動こうという気力も湧かず。
findings.explanation: Haruki has no energy or will to move even if it means taking a taxi. The English says his fatigue makes him want to call one, reversing his paralysis into a desire for transport.
findings.japanese:
始発が動き出すまでにはまだ時間があり、
タクシーを使ってまで動こうという気力も湧かず。
findings.todokanai: There's still some time before the first train departs, and I feel tired enough to want to call a taxi.

findings.highlight: Put it in your pocket and you'll feel nice and warm… oh, what am I saying?
findings.evidenceJa: 「これ、使い捨てカイロ。懐に入れて温めておきました…なんてね」
findings.explanation: Setsuna says she kept the disposable warmer inside her clothes to warm it for Haruki, then playfully retracts the intimate claim. The English tells Haruki to put it in his own pocket and makes her embarrassment causeless.
findings.japanese:
「これ、使い捨てカイロ。
懐に入れて温めておきました…なんてね」
findings.todokanai: "Here, take this disposable heat pack. Put it in your pocket and you'll feel nice and warm… oh, what am I saying?"

findings.highlight: That I'd stay by Kazusa's side from now on.
findings.evidenceJa: かずさから逃げないって。今はかずさの側にいるって。
findings.explanation: Haruki promised not to flee Kazusa and to remain beside her for now, until she was reassured. 'From now on' extends the bounded crisis commitment into an indefinite future and conflicts with the condition stated two lines later.
findings.japanese:
かずさから逃げないって。
今はかずさの側にいるって。
findings.todokanai: That I wouldn't run away from Kazusa. That I'd stay by Kazusa's side from now on.

findings.highlight: "No, perhaps it was a mistake to even suggest that I would be able to support her in the first place… In the end, it was all pointless."
findings.evidenceJa:
「いや、俺が支えようとすることそのものが
間違ってたのかも。
…やっぱり俺じゃ、駄目だったんだ」
findings.explanation: Haruki concludes that he himself is no good for Kazusa; 'it was all pointless' relocates the judgment to the effort — His self-condemnation and Setsuna's denial remain emotionally aligned.
findings.japanese:
「いや、俺が支えようとすることそのものが
間違ってたのかも。
…やっぱり俺じゃ、駄目だったんだ」
findings.todokanai: "No, perhaps it was a mistake to even suggest that I would be able to support her in the first place… In the end, it was all pointless."

findings.highlight: how much you've been held down as well
findings.evidenceJa: 「この二週間のこと。春希くんがどう頑張って、どう挫折したのかを」
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks how Haruki tried and how he failed or broke down. The English says he was 'held down,' shifting his acknowledged failure into something externally done to him.
findings.japanese:
「この二週間のこと。
春希くんがどう頑張って、どう挫折したのかを」
findings.todokanai: "Tell me everything that's happened these two weeks. How much you've worked hard, Haruki-kun, and how much you've been held down as well…"

findings.highlight: you didn't even want to take the initiative to contact me at all.
findings.evidenceJa: 「あ～あ、連絡欲しかったな。かずさ、昔の携帯番号繋がらないし。何より、わたしから連絡入れても嫌だろうし」
findings.explanation: Setsuna wanted contact, but Kazusa's old number no longer worked and Setsuna assumed Kazusa would hate being contacted by her. The English instead says Kazusa did not want to initiate contact, reversing who contemplated calling whom.
findings.japanese:
「あ～あ、連絡欲しかったな。
かずさ、昔の携帯番号繋がらないし。
何より、わたしから連絡入れても嫌だろうし」
findings.todokanai: "Aa-ah, I really wanted to get in touch with you. Your old phone number doesn't work anymore, after all, and more importantly, you didn't even want to take the initiative to contact me at all."

findings.highlight: She had her doubts, of course.
findings.evidenceJa: 「もちろん、コネはあったよ。春希くんが直接曜子さんに口利きしたから、理屈抜きでウチが仕事を取れた」
findings.explanation: Setsuna admits they had connections: Haruki directly put in a word with Youko, letting Knights obtain the work outside normal logic. The English translates コネ as doubts, making the next sentence disconnected.
findings.japanese:
「もちろん、コネはあったよ。
春希くんが直接曜子さんに口利きしたから、
理屈抜きでウチが仕事を取れた」
findings.todokanai: "She had her doubts, of course. It was Haruki-kun who managed to persuade Youko-san and make her give this job over to us."

findings.highlight: You'd be happy as long as Haruki-kun reciprocated your feelings?
findings.evidenceJa: 「ただ、好きな人を振り向かせられたら良かった？…春希くんにさえ、届けば良かった？」
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks whether Kazusa wanted only to make her beloved turn toward her—if only she could reach Haruki. The English converts 届く, the work's load-bearing reach/unreachable motif, into explicit reciprocation.
findings.japanese:
「ただ、好きな人を振り向かせられたら良かった？
…春希くんにさえ、届けば良かった？」
findings.todokanai: "You'd be happy by simply having the person you love look at you? …You'd be happy as long as Haruki-kun reciprocated your feelings?"

findings.highlight: I do remember something like that happening in the past.
findings.evidenceJa: 「あと二週間かぁ…昔も、そんなやっつけ仕事があったね」
findings.explanation: Setsuna pointedly recalls another two-week rush job: the improvised school-festival performance that formed the trio. The vague English loses both やっつけ仕事 ('rush/slapdash job') and the callback binding this recording project to that origin.
findings.japanese:
「あと二週間かぁ…
昔も、そんなやっつけ仕事があったね」
findings.todokanai: "Two weeks left… I do remember something like that happening in the past."
